question.text: Which of the following must be disclosed in a Cat III AIF's Investor Charter?

answer.text: Vision/Mission, services, grievance redressal, timelines, investor responsibilities

explanation.text: The Logic: Per pages 140-141, the Investor Charter must contain vision and mission, business transacted, services, timelines, grievance redressal, and investor responsibilities. The Trap: Investment philosophy alone, portfolio holdings, or detailed performance track record are not part of the Investor Charter content list. Note: Pages 140-141 also describe how the Investor Charter is disclosed to investors, anchoring both the contents and the disclosure method to source.
